headline: Colombia September Unemployment Rate Drops to 8%
summary: Colombia's unemployment rate fell to 8% in September, with 322,000 more people employed compared to 2025, while the participation rate declined to 63.8%.
why: Employment data is a primary macroeconomic indicator reflecting labor market tightness, consumer purchasing power, and domestic economic momentum.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Lower unemployment indicates strengthening domestic labor market conditions and broader economic health.
